description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of token routing within the FedHLM system, specifically for the EDGE_P2P configuration. The chart contains four slices representing different routing destinations. A large green slice labeled “LOCAL” occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. A red slice labeled “LLM” represents approximately 3.9% of the chart, while a blue slice labeled “EDGE_P2P” accounts for roughly 1.6%. A smaller, unlabeled dark red slice makes up the remaining portion of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is present, identifying the labels associated with each color. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, with the largest slice, “LOCAL”, positioned at the bottom of the chart.
